notes.title: Cozy Designer is coming August 30th!
notes.content:
Calling all designers!

We’re excited to announce that Cozy Designer is [b]coming on August 30th![/b]

We’ve improved a lot of things to make your experience even better, but we’d like to highlight one of them below:

One of the most requested features from our community of players was that the photo mode at the end of the level could be activated manually by the player instead of automatically when placing the last item. We heard you! But if you want to keep the automatic mode, just enable the option again in the Options menu.

The final version of the game will feature 60 rooms and you can decorate and redecorate as many times as you like!

We hope to see you on August 30th!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hey designers!

We have updated the Cozy Designer demo to version 0.3.0 DEMO.
Check out what has changed below:

- We added a counter of remaining objects in the bottom left corner, so you can know when photo mode is coming and make any adjustments as necessary.

- We have also added a new level for you to play, as a thank you for all the support we have received.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s3kT4gK.jpeg[/img]

You can also play the Cozy Designer playlist while working, studying or being with your loved ones, just access the "Music Mode" option in the main menu.

Have a good game and relax!

notes.title: 🛋️🖼️ Let's play the demo!
notes.content:
Calling all designers!

You are very welcome to tune in to Cozy Designer streaming during Next Fest.

To play the free demo, add to your wishlist or find out more information about the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832650/Cozy_Designer/]click here and access the game's official page.[/url]

We're really curious to see what you'll be able to create in Cozy Designer, so feel free to share your designs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2832650]in our community![/url]

The full game with 60 playable levels will be released in August this year, so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832650/Cozy_Designer/]add Cozy Designer to your wishlist[/url] to be notified when the game is released with a 25% discount.
